decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed use at first floor would result in an inappropriate employment use for the area, given the primary function of LSIS for industrial and warehouse uses, for which no justification has been provided and the creation of a trip-generating leisure facility in an out of centre location, which would be incompatible with the primary function of LSIS, the premises and the adjoining estate, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies C.5.1, C.5.4 and policy EP6 of the Council's adopted Employment Development Plan Document.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed use would be likely to give rise to unacceptable noise and disturbance, harmful to neighbours' living conditions, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development).

Condition : 3 - 3.	The proposal would also be unacceptable in terms of off-street parking provision and parking layout, access and safety, providing insufficient on-site car parking in a configuration that would be harmful to the free flow and safety of pedestrians and vehicles on the adjoining highway, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking Facilities For Developments) and T.4.6 (Off-Street Parking).
description: Front extension at ground floor and retention of use to offices at ground floor level, and the construction of a first floor to provide a karate club
